candidates.explanation: The refresh token is signed with expiresIn read from 'auth.expires' (the short access-token lifetime) rather than 'auth.refreshExpires' (AUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRES_IN). So the refresh JWT's exp is only minutes after iat, and /auth/refresh rejects it with 401 once the access-token lifetime has passed.

fix.description: Use the refresh expiry config key when signing the refresh token: replace getOrThrow('auth.expires') with getOrThrow('auth.refreshExpires', { infer: true }) in the refresh token signAsync options.

candidates.explanation: The refresh token is signed with expiresIn read from 'auth.expires' (the short access-token lifetime) rather than 'auth.refreshExpires' (AUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRES_IN). So the refresh JWT's exp is only minutes after iat, and /auth/refresh rejects it with 401 once the access-token lifetime has passed.
